class.name: WeatherLightningEffect
class.brief_description: Lightning flashes and cloud-to-ground bolts for a [Weather] node.
class.description: Fires lightning at the weather's [member WeatherProfile.lightning_per_minute], in game only; [method strike] and the [b]Strike Lightning[/b] button work in the editor too. Each flash is one to four return strokes within about a second, the flicker of real lightning. Every stroke lights the scene through a directional light from the strike (no shadows, no second sun in the sky) and the clouds near it through the [WeatherSkyEffect]. A share of the flashes ([member ground_strike_chance]) are visible cloud-to-ground bolts; the rest light the clouds from inside, as most real lightning does. A bolt is built by midpoint displacement, with branches off its upper part, and drawn as glowing camera-facing ribbons. A faint leader grows down from the cloud before the first stroke. Bolts stay inside the camera's far plane, and rain and fog dim distant ones. The [Weather] node emits [signal Weather.lightning_struck] at every flash, for thunder or gameplay. [codeblock] var lightning := weather.get_effect(&"WeatherLightningEffect") as WeatherLightningEffect lightning.strike(400.0, 1) # A bolt 400 m away. [/codeblock]

method.name: get_direction
method.description: The direction from the camera toward the last flash.

method.name: get_flash
method.description: The brightness of the flash this frame, [code]0.0[/code] between flashes and up to [code]1.0[/code] at the first return stroke.

method.name: is_bolt_visible
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while a bolt is shown.

method.name: preview_strike
method.description: Fires a ground strike now and keeps the bolt lit for [member preview_hold_time] seconds, to look at it. The [b]Strike Lightning[/b] button calls it.

method.name: strike
method.description: Fires a flash now, [param distance] meters away (random between [member distance_min] and [member distance_max] when negative). [param ground_strike] [code]1[/code] makes a bolt to the ground, [code]0[/code] a flash inside the clouds, [code]-1[/code] picks at random with [member ground_strike_chance]. The effect must be running.

members.member: The render layers of the bolt.
Subdivision levels of a bolt's main channel: it has [code]2^bolt_levels[/code] segments.
How far each midpoint of the channel is pushed sideways, relative to the length of its segment.
The height of the cloud base the bolts come down from, above the camera, in meters.
The colour of the flash light and of the lit clouds.
The farthest a random strike lands, in meters.
The nearest a random strike lands, in meters. Near strikes light the scene more.
The energy of the flash light at the first return stroke of a strike at middle distance.
The colour of the glow around the bolt's white core.
The share of flashes that are cloud-to-ground bolts. In reality about a quarter of lightning reaches the ground.
The most branches a bolt has (at least half of this).
How long [method preview_strike] keeps the bolt lit. Strikes in the game always use real timing.
The [b]Strike Lightning[/b] button in the inspector: calls [method preview_strike].
